w:r.w:t: <description>Monitoring Sutrefia security-policy compliance through authentication, endpoint, software and system-configuration events using Splunk BOTSv3.</description>
<title>Monitors failed Windows authentication attempts over time to identify suspicious login activities, repeated login failures, and potential brute-force attacks.</title>
<title>Tracks successful Windows authentication events over time to monitor legitimate user access and identify unusual login patterns.</title>
| stats count AS Signin_Events by MFA_Status</query>
<title>Tracks the most frequent endpoint processes to identify unusual activity.</title>
| stats count AS Execution_Count by ProcessName
<title>Tracks installed software and versions across hosts to identify outdated or unauthorised applications.</title>
| stats count AS Observations by host DisplayName DisplayVersion
<title>Monitors outbound network connections and destination ports to identify unusual communication activity</title>
| stats count AS Connection_Count by DestinationIP DestinationPort
